firm.rules: The referee re-solves every plan at once (every campus and upgrade), prices it with the engine's own figures (high end; the planners' numbers are never used) and runs the full cascade with every line in service: nothing may trip and nobody may lose power. Most campuses within the budget wins, then the cheapest, then the fewest upgrades; an AI plan must beat the engine's to win.
firm.note: Every number describes the synthetic grid model (Breakthrough Energy / Texas A&M), not any real utility's network; costs are estimates (high end).

flexible.sentence: The engine's plan stands: 7 campuses at once for $6.2M. Gemini's Cheapest first matched it (7 campuses for $6.2M) but didn't beat it.
flexible.rules: The referee re-solves every plan at once (every campus and upgrade, at both load levels), prices it with the engine's own figures (high end; the planners' numbers are never used) and runs the full cascade with every line in service: nothing may trip and nobody may lose power. Most campuses within the budget wins, then the cheapest, then the fewest upgrades; an AI plan must beat the engine's to win.
flexible.note: Every number describes the synthetic grid model (Breakthrough Energy / Texas A&M), not any real utility's network; costs are estimates (high end).
